article.summary_es: HOPE Center Development Corporation es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los sábados.
article.summary_en: HOPE Center Development Corporation is a food pantry in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open on Saturdays.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 414 E 95th St, Brooklyn, NY 11212.
Atiende los sábados de 11am a 1:30pm (los primeros cuatro sábados del mes).
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 414 E 95th St, Brooklyn, NY 11212.
It is open Saturdays 11am-1:30pm (1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th Saturdays).
visit_tips_es: La despensa abre los sábados de 11am a 1:30pm.
La lista no indica qué alimentos se entregan ni si hay requisitos; pregunte por teléfono antes de ir.
Verifique los días exactos, ya que atiende solo los primeros cuatro sábados del mes.
visit_tips_en: The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements; call ahead to ask.
Check the exact days, since it operates only on the first four Saturdays of the month.
